title: China Medical University Hospital's exercise-ECG AI catching a 99% coronary stenosis that manual reading had rated moderate, Taichung, 2022
summary: CMUH's exercise-ECG AI put severe-blockage odds at 72% where manual reading said follow-up; angiography found a 99% LAD stenosis, stented.
account: A 75-year-old man surnamed Chen, with controlled hypertension, woke one day with chest tightness and palpitations first taken for reflux. Liberty Times puts the onset in 2021. At China Medical University Hospital (CMUH), Taichung, his exercise electrocardiogram (ECG) was read manually with a risk score. That gave about 50% blockage, moderate risk, follow-up only. The hospital's own Exercise ECG AI-Assisted Interpretation System, in use since May 2022, put the probability of severe (over 70%) narrowing at 72%. So cardiologist 吳宏彬 ordered angiography, found a 99% stenosis of the left anterior descending artery and stented it at once. He went home, chest tightness resolved. The hospital presented it on 28 December 2022. Test and procedure dates are not reported.
purpose: The hospital's AI Center built the system to judge from an exercise ECG whether a patient's coronary arteries are severely narrowed (over 70%). Manual reading of a dozen tracings is slow and, the hospital says, only 40–50% accurate. Flagging this patient's severe stenosis was exactly that purpose.
system: 運動心電圖AI輔助判讀系統 (Exercise ECG AI-Assisted Interpretation System), China Medical University Hospital
model_version: Not reported. The hospital describes a deep-learning model that takes exercise-ECG signals at three time points plus 10 measured and 2 derived features (such as history and maximum workload), trained on nearly 1,000 exercise ECGs matched to catheterization data, accuracy about 80%, sensitivity 88%, in clinical use since May 2022; the authors' 2025 paper describes a convolutional recurrent network with three ECG slices and 12 features, AUC 0.83, sensitivity 0.89, specificity 0.60.
developer: China Medical University Hospital (中國醫藥大學附設醫院人工智慧中心), director 許凱程
deployer: China Medical University Hospital, Division of Cardiology (心臟血管系), Taichung

ratings.reason: A man with a 99% stenosis of the left anterior descending artery had it stented after the AI flagged a 72% probability of severe narrowing. The manual exercise-ECG reading had rated it moderate and left it for drug treatment and follow-up. The cardiologist put his chance of an acute infarction at 8 in 10. He said the stent removed the sudden-death risk. He left hospital, symptoms resolved. The hospital's headlines call it life-saving, but the harm was prospective and the account is the developer-hospital's own, so life-saving is not established.

ai_role.statement: The model read the exercise-ECG signals and report features. It returned a 72% probability of severe coronary narrowing, above the moderate-risk verdict of the manual reading and risk score. On that basis the cardiologist ordered angiography, which showed the 99% stenosis, and he stented it. The counterfactual rests on the treating cardiologist's statement, carried by three outlets and the hospital's release. He said the manual reading would have led to drug treatment and follow-up only. The hospital that says so also built the model. The dates of the reading and procedure are not reported. The published model's specificity of 0.60 means such flags are often false positives.

must_hold: The model is run in addition to, not instead of, the clinician's reading. The hospital calls it assisted interpretation and a clinician made every decision
